echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance
echo_sets.note: 2-pc gives 10% Spectro DMG; 5-pc gives 20% Crit Rate when inflicting Spectro Frazzle and 15% Spectro DMG Bonus against enemies at 10+ Frazzle stacks. Capitaneus (3-cost main) adds Spectro and Heavy Attack DMG; Nightmare: Mourning Aix (4-cost) is the alternative main.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Noticeably weaker than Eternal Radiance, but usable while farming it; grants Spectro DMG that spikes further after an Intro Skill.

echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance + Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Stopgap 2+2 split for Spectro DMG while completing a 5-pc Eternal Radiance set.

build.energy_regen_target: No fixed target from guides — ER is a low-priority substat for Zani; stack only enough for comfortable Liberation uptime.
build.fast_path: Fast path: Blazing Justice + 5-piece Eternal Radiance in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Capitaneus in the main slot. Aim for Crit DMG on the 4-cost, Spectro DMG Bonus on the 3-costs, ATK% on the 1-costs, and push Crit Rate/Crit DMG/ATK% substats. Energy Regen is a low priority — only enough for comfortable Liberation uptime.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Justice
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit DMG substat, ATK boost, DEF ignore on Basic Attacks, and a large Spectro Frazzle DMG amplification. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Tragicomedy
ranked_weapons.note: Phoebe's signature gauntlets; Crit Rate substat plus a Heavy Attack DMG buff that lines up with Zani's burst window.

ranked_weapons.name: Verity's Handle
ranked_weapons.note: Attribute bonus buff and Resonance Liberation DMG; weaker uptime than Tragicomedy if Liberations are infrequent.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: Solid fallback if you need more Energy Regen; otherwise outclassed by the Crit weapons above.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: Best 4-star option from the battle pass; Crit Rate plus Resonance Liberation DMG, though the Liberation scaling is less valuable for her than Heavy Attack DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% stat stick with easier Liberation cycling after Resonance Skill; serviceable placeholder.

stat_priorities.note: Eternal Radiance 5-pc already grants 20% Crit Rate on Frazzle, so Crit DMG usually wins; use Crit Rate if your substats are lacking.
Spectro DMG Bonus on both 3-costs; the core of her Frazzle scaling.

profile.role_note: Spectro Frazzle-based burst DPS; pairs with Phoebe, who applies Spectro Frazzle for her.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Skip pulling specifically for her right now — she has no active banner, and she needs Phoebe (or another Frazzle applier) to reach her full potential. She remains one of the strongest Frazzle carries in the game, but newer dedicated DPS options have closed the gap, so only chase her rerun if you already run a Spectro Frazzle team or like her heavy-attack burst playstyle.

teams.name: Budget: Zani + Spectro Rover + Verina

tier_badge.label: Strong DPS
tier_badge.note: Sources disagree on her current standing: Beebom's October 2026 version 3.7 tier list keeps Zani in S, while GachaGo's October 2026 list dropped her to C (from B) citing newer competition, and MMO Culture's v3.6 list has her at A. She remains strong in dedicated Frazzle teams but is no longer a universal top pick.
